title: Crusty Flatbread with American Cheese
description: A Japanese-inspired twist on American comfort food, this crispy flatbread is topped with a rich and creamy American cheese.
instructions: 2. Slice the crusty flatbread into 1-inch squares.
3. Place the flatbread squares on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
4. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
5. Meanwhile, melt 2-3 slices of American cheese in a small saucepan over low heat.
6. Remove the flatbread from the oven and top each piece with a slice of melted cheese.
7. If using, sprinkle with American seasoning.
8. Return the flatbread to the oven and bake for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly and golden brown.
9. Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
